description.zh:
指定要查询的主机ID。仅支持输入一个主机ID。
> 您可以调用[ListHosts](~~200665~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the host that you want to query. You can specify only one host ID.

> You can call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to query the ID of the host.

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host in which you want to query the host.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host in which you want to query the host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 获取指定主机的详细信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
